data.gender_notes: Amol is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Amol is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is composed of the words 'Amar' and 'Lila'. 'Amar' means immortal or everlasting, while 'Lila' refers to play or sport. Thus, the name Amol can be interpreted as 'the immortal play' or 'the everlasting sport'. In Hindu mythology, Amol is associated with the god Vishnu, who is believed to play the cosmic game of creation and destruction.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the eternal nature of the soul and the cyclical nature of the universe.
data.etymology: Amol belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Immortal, Everlasting.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amol total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
